pattern: Generated cards keep the whole object inside the frame. They center it, leave even space on every side, and often add a base or extra props (island, rocks, bubbles, a kettle) that compete with the hero. Real cards push in close, so the hero is cut off by an edge, usually the bottom. The hero is the one clear focal point.
